messages:
deploy-bot: Kicking off staged canary for release v3.18 -> eu-west-1 (group=4). Change window 2026-04-10 11:00-12:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood.dev/releases/v3.18 PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/456
jordan: Quick ask: where's the backout/runbook link and who is rollback owner for canary? Need pin command ready too. :eyes:
meera: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/OPS/Backout-v3.18-rapid. I'll take rollback ownership for canary unless someone else wants it.
tay: Ops pin (staged pin): `rdeploy pin --cluster canary --image redwood:v3.17 --mode staged --duration 40m --note "temp pin during canary regression"`
tay: Emergency hotpin: `rdeploy hotpin --cluster canary --image redwood:v3.18 --threshold p95=195ms --duration 15m` (only use if small ingress blip).
ops-bot: Feature flag note: `ff/pgm/async_migrations` is OFF on canary. If migrations fail, toggle with `ffctl set ff/pgm/async_migrations false --env canary`. Pager for rollback owner will be posted when assigned.
oncall-bot: Rollback owner: meera. Pager: +1-555-0303. Escalation: oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-platform.
jordan: Please paste a short, actionable rollback checklist into this thread for quick copy/paste.
meera: Rollback checklist (copyable):
1) `rdeploy rollback --to-tag redwood:v3.17 --cluster canary`
2) `kubectl rollout status deployment/edge-proxy -n redwood` and `kubectl rollout restart deployment/edge-proxy -n redwood` if stuck
3) Clear local caches: `redis-cli -h cache.canary FLUSHDB` and `memcached-tool canary flush_all`
4) Verify no DB migration errors: `kubectl logs -n redwood -l app=db-migrator | grep -i error`
5) Reconcile feature flags: ensure `ff/pgm/async_migrations=false` on canary
6) Post status here and notify product to prepare release-note revert text
jordan: Nice. Also add a short note about when to pin stable vs rollback fully.
meera: Rule of thumb: if only canary ingress latency spikes and error-rate <0.4%, prefer staged pin/hotpin. If 5xxs >0.6% or DB schema errors appear, full rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 1/4 OK, 2/4 OK, 3/4 degraded (p95=205ms) -> auto-pause triggered by alert `p95>190ms` for 2m. Holding further rollouts.
jordan: Auto-pause seen. Meera, recommend go immediate rollback given p95 and small uptick in 5xxs?
meera: Confirming 5xx creeping to 0.7% and worker logs show transient schema warnings. Full rollback now. Executing step 1.
deploy-bot: Rollback command executed by meera at 2026-04-10T11:07:45Z. Tracking progress.
meera: Rollback completed on canary clusters. Running post-rollback checks (restart proxy, flush caches, check migrator logs).
ops-bot: Post-rollback health: p95=92ms, error-rate=0.12%, migrator logs show no active schema failures. Recommend 12m observation window.
product-bot: Product notified. Drafting rollback note and will update release page with a short explanation for customers.
jordan: Thanks. Can someone add a 2-3 line postmortem summary to the release ticket and flag whether we want a reattempt in next change window?
meera: Will add PM note and propose reattempt after root-cause triage (likely migration ordering issue). Scheduling short retro with infra and db teams.
jordan: Great. Closing this thread once PM note is in. :thumbsup:
